milestone.name: K7.7.4 - Wake Transition Runtime
milestone.summary: Freeze provider-facing wake transition context and opening intent without generating final Julia text.

review.name: K7.7.4 Wake Transition Runtime Contract Freeze

principle: Wake Transition cannot create Julia. It can only express the already recovered Julia state.
acceptance_targets: Runtime constructs Wake Context from absence duration, re-entry confidence, state strength, and freshness.
Runtime applies Transition Policy: short absence continue, medium absence bridge, long absence reorient.
Runtime outputs Opening Intent, not final Julia text.
Opening Intent includes intent, tone, depth, continuity usage, and avoid behaviors.
Wake transition avoids fixed phrase output.
Short absence can strongly continue cognitive momentum.
Medium absence bridges previous state and current intent.
Long absence reorients and does not pretend yesterday's emotional state is still active.
Wake transition does not reintroduce identity if re-entry state is sufficient.
Wake transition does not dump archive, relationship artifact, re-entry state, or architecture internals.
Wake transition does not mutate identity, relationship, memory, or experience.
K7.7.3 RNS benchmark remains the validation gate for natural re-entry.
